summary: Create standardized 1-pager: Usage Insights (route-level cost drivers) + export limitations for enterprise security reviews
description:
Requesting team(s): Sales + Customer Success

Context
We’re seeing repeated enterprise security reviews asking the same set of questions about the new in-console “Usage Insights” (cost drivers by route/model) and the export/reporting workflow. Sales/CS needs a single standardized one-pager they can attach to security questionnaires and share during procurement.

Problem
Responses today are ad-hoc (Slack snippets + links). This is slowing down deals and producing inconsistent messaging around:
- What exactly “route” means and how it is set
- Cardinality and what happens when routes are missing/invalid
- Export contents, limits, retention, and residency behavior
- Audit logging for export and download actions
- How exports respect RBAC/org/project boundaries
- Why console route-level totals may not match invoices exactly

Deliverable
A standardized one-pager (1 page, PDF + doc link) that covers:
1) Feature overview (Usage Insights: cost + latency by route/model)
2) Data scope + attribution basics (route definition, model breakdown, fallback attribution at a high level)
3) Export workflow overview (CSV + JSON exports; bounded report)
4) Security controls (RBAC, tenant isolation, audit logging fields, retention)
5) Operational limitations (cardinality guardrails, time range limits, late-arriving data, invoice reconciliation disclaimer)
6) Customer actions / prerequisites (route tagging guidance; what happens if not tagged)

Format guidance
- One-pager should be readable by security reviewers and FinOps stakeholders.
- Minimal product marketing; prefer clear statements, bullets, and “limitations/notes.”
- Include a “Last updated” date and a contact alias (e.g., #support-internal / Security & Compliance contact).

Acceptance criteria
- Reviewed by Security/Compliance (audit/RBAC/retention wording)
- Reviewed by Product PM for accuracy
- Published in an internal shareable location and linked from the Sales/CS enablement hub

Requester notes
- Specifically needed for Dedicated + Private prospects asking about export auditing and data boundaries.

Target due date
2026-02-19 (needed ahead of several security follow-ups).

Attachments/links (references)
- Confluence: Security spec for export audit events (usage-report-export-audit-events)
- Confluence: API contract addendum (usage-insights-analytics-api-contract)
- Confluence: Cardinality guardrails (cost-attribution-cardinality-guardrails)
- Draft docs/PRD for usage insights + export FAQ (console usage insights + export docs)

Confirming intended behavior for the one-pager wording:

- Retention: exported artifacts are stored short-term for download (TTL) and audit logs retained per audit policy. Please avoid claiming “customer-configurable retention” for GA.

Suggest including: ‘Exports are auditable and access-controlled; artifacts are ephemeral; audit logs are retained.’
